messages:
Alex: Quick thread to coordinate a compact migration + examples page for function/tool calling. Need python + ts + a tiny schema + fallback note.
Priya: I'll draft the migration steps: validate -> compat shim -> heuristic fallback. Keep it 3 bullets.
Mei: I'll write the canonical snippets. Aim for <30 lines each and include one Go micro-example (customers asked).
Julian: I'll add guardrail examples: missing required, extra keys, nullable arrays. Small unit tests in docs CI.
docs-bot: Link scan: 5 broken anchors in examples/legacy-toolcalls. Suggest redirects to /docs/callables/compact.md
Alex: Proposed inline schema (feel free to simplify):
```json
{
  "type":"object",
  "properties":{
    "op":{"type":"string"},
    "params":{"oneOf":[{"type":"null"},{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}]}
  },
  "required":["op"]
}
```
Priya: Snippets will mention `from rwd.compat import call_tool_legacy` for older SDKs. Also note tokenization truncation as a rare cause for malformed JSON.
Mei: Python example draft:
```python
resp = rwd.chat.call_tool("lookup", {"q":"status"})
if resp.is_structured():
  data = resp.parse_json()
else:
  data = fallback_parse(resp.text)
```
Mei: TS example will mirror and show runtime schema validation with `ajv`.
Julian: I'll wire testcases to run in docs CI and add a tiny regex cleanup step for trailing commas.
Alex: Timeline: drafts by EOD Wednesday, reviewers tagged (devex + docowner), merge next Monday. Tag `devex` when PRs are ready.
Priya: Opening migration PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4970 (WIP).
Mei: Opening snippets PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4971.
Julian: Added CI tests branch -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4972.
docs-bot: CI link-check queued.
Alex: Thanks — will do a final sweep for wording and archive the legacy pages via redirect once merged. Keep follow-ups here.
